# Final Policy Report

**Due:** Sun Aug 23, 2026 11:59pm  
**Points:** 25

## Details

This assignment is the written component of your final project presentation and analysis. Students will produce a ~5-page interactive HTML report using R and R Markdown that presents their analysis of a selected policy issue. The report should include the following components:

## Executive Summary

In no more than three paragraphs, clearly summarize the policy issue, research questions, analytical approach, and main findings. This section should provide a concise synthesis of your entire project. After reading it, a policymaker should underst‚and what you did, why it matters, and what you found.

## Motivation and Research Questions

Describe the policy issue, including appropriate references, and explain its relevance and significance. Clearly state your research questions.

## Data

Describe the dataset(s) used to address your research questions, including any data cleaning and preparation steps undertaken to create your analytical dataset.

## Methodology

Explain your analytical approach, including what was done and why this method was selected. Justify why the chosen approach is appropriate for addressing your research question(s).

## Key Findings

Present your main results in clear, accessible language. Your explanation should be understandable to an audience without a quantitative background. Include statistical descriptions of all measures used in the analysis with appropriate graphs or tables.

## Conclusion and Policy Implications

Summarize your key findings and discuss their broader implications for policymakers.

# Submission Requirements

For this final assignment, students are required to submit:

- The HTML report.
- An R script (.R file) that prepares the data for analysis and runs the report.
- An R Markdown script (.Rmd file) that produces the HTML report.

All code should follow the formatting conventions demonstrated in class, and be clearly commented.

| Methodology | Clearly explains the analytical approach, why it was selected, and why it is appropriate for answering the research question(s). | 3 | 6 |
